reason: I'd probably start the free trial like I do with everything, but I'd cancel before day 4. $147 a month is a lot when I make under $5k, and there are no customer results anywhere, so I'd be the guinea pig.
objection: It only sends while Instagram is open in my Chrome, so I'd have to keep a tab open for hours every day. I also have no proof it books calls, and if my IG account gets flagged I lose my only lead source.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from agency owners my size, like booked calls per month, plus a plan around $59-79 with no card needed for the trial.
